Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //vaw,'. dilg.gov.ph OPINION NO. LO 03 SEP 2017 HON. LORNA S. ESPINA Mayor Mahayag, Zamboanga del Sur Dear Mayor Espina: This has reference to your letter dated 17 August 2017, which was forwarded to the Central Office by DILG-Region IX Director Paisal O. Abutazil for appropriate action, soliciting clarification on who is the legal Mayor of Mahayag, Zamboanga del Sur and at the same time, requesting assistance and/or order for the Acting Mayor to step down on the ground that the preventive suspension order previously issued against you could not yet be given force and effect in view of the onset of the 90-day prohibited period under Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991. In DILG Opinion No. 18, series of 2017 dated 15 August 2017, it may be recalled that the Department opined and we quote: Per the documents forwarded to the Central Office, the Orderp/acing you (Mayor Lorna Espina) under preventive suspension was issued by Governor Cerilles on 04 August 2017, thus within the 90-dayprohibited period under Section 62 (c) ofthe Local Government Code of 1991. Since the aforesaid Order contravenes Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991, it could not be given force and effect. Despite the foregoing clarification, you represented in your letter that Acting Mayor Camila T. Diaz (Diaz) refused to follow the same because according to her, there was nothing in the order requiring her to step down and go back as Vice-Mayor. Up to the date of your letter, Diaz still performs the functions and duties of the Office of the Mayor. Hence, your letter-request. Section 46 of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 mandates the municipal vice-mayor to automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the municipal mayor in case the latter is temporarily incapacitated to perform such duties for physical or legal reasons, such as suspension from office. This duty of the municipal vice-mayor is reiterated under Section 445 (a)(4) of the Local Government Code of 1991.

It goes without saying that when the physical or legal reason, which paved the way for a temporary vacancy in the Office of the Mayor, does not subsist due to, for example, the application of a provision of law, such as herein Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code, it is incumbent on the Acting Mayor, to go back to his previous position. We hope to have guided you accordingly. l,s/17 Copy furnished: DIR. PAISAL O. ABUTAZIL DILG REGION SS Paiaves Ave. , San Francisco District, Pagadian City Ve ruly yours, AUSTERE A.
